tool.name: Perseus Extract Features
tool.description: extract lineage-aware features from a Kraken2 output file
tool.command: @CMD_EXTRACT_TAXONOMY_DB@ mkdir -p feature_shards && perseus extract '$kraken_input' feature_shards taxonomy_db --min-tax-kmers $min_tax_kmers --threads "\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" && tar -cf '$feature_shards_output' -C feature_shards .

param.label: Minimum taxonomic k-mers per sequence
param.help: Sequences with fewer taxonomic k-mers than this are excluded from the output (0 = include all sequences)

tool.help:
**What it does**
Extracts a lineage-aware feature matrix from a Kraken2 output file (the per-read classification file, not the report file). Features are written as a directory of sharded files that the `Filter Kraken2 Output` tool consumes together with the same Kraken2 output file to compute per-rank confidence probabilities.
The output of this tool is a single tar archive containing the shard directory; use it directly as the "Feature shards" input of the `Filter Kraken2 Output` tool.
-----
**Inputs**
- **Kraken2 output file**: the per-read classification file produced by Kraken2 (columns: classified/unclassified, sequence ID, taxonomy ID, length, k-mer LCA mapping). - **ETE3 taxonomy database**: the tar archive produced by the `Perseus Setup Taxonomy Database` tool.
-----
**About Perseus**
Perseus is a post-processing framework for refining Kraken2 taxonomic classifications, with a focus on long-read metagenomics (PacBio HiFi, ONT).
